satisfaction_reasons: Current overall quality is 683/90 = 7.5(8), half-up 7.6, below the 8.0 progression line.

Round 2 fixed the round-1 structural defects I flagged (phone table clipping, Discovered header stretch, competing filled buttons, nested Settings fieldsets, faint Remove, card shadow), worth +1.1 on the mean.
Remaining defects are visible and repeatable across surfaces (see strongest_findings); none is a breakage, but together they hold most screens at 7-8 rather than 8+.
Independent satisfaction is mine alone; no peer, brand or historical score was pooled or consulted.

strongest_findings.finding: A filled header "Add service"/"Add record" and an outlined form submit carry the same label; the button that actually commits is demoted to secondary.
The sideways nav row starts or ends on a clipped label/icon ("cklists", "ecords", partial search icon) with no fade, chevron or other scroll cue.

The 5-column and 4-column stat rows use different grids so dividers do not align; on phones the stat grid keeps a ~38px inset (left over from the removed card) against the 16px edge, with Uptime orphaned. Counts repeat in the legend and table; orange doubles as a data hue (declined, kept as recorded).

Native bold "▶ Direct" disclosure marker reads like a play glyph rather than the contract chevron; the "Send DNS to the proxy" checkbox sits in the label column while its help starts in the input column (same checkbox/label-column split on DHCP and Settings).
Narrow Name column wraps the description to eight lines (~220px row) and the mono source URL breaks mid-token; three pill variants on one page.
Left/right label-value columns sit on staggered baselines and a lone danger Remove takes its own line per row, making Remove the loudest colour on the page.
The guidance still opens the quoted button name with a closing quote glyph (”Fill in from this interface”); flagged in round 1 and not listed in the responses.
Settings fields and rules end at ~1016px while Save settings aligns to 1240px (two right edges). Discovered's only next action is an orange, non-underlined inline link.

recommended_batch.scope: One bounded alignment-and-affordance batch; no new features, copy claims or behaviour changes.
items: List pages: make the form submit the visible committing action (e.g. header link quiet/secondary or anchor-styled, submit filled), or otherwise remove the same-label primary/secondary pair. Ask the owner before relabelling.
Phone nav: add a scroll cue (edge fade or chevron) to the nav row so clipped labels read as scrollable.
Shared form grid: put checkbox rows and help text on the input column (Services, DHCP, Settings); replace the native disclosure marker with the contract chevron on Services routing.
Dashboard: one grid for both stat rows; remove the leftover phone stat inset so stats align to the 16px edge.
Blacklists: give the Name/description column more width or clamp it, and break URLs at "/" rather than mid-token.
Fix the DHCP opening quote glyph; cap Settings Save to the form column edge.
recommended_batch.not_a_promise: Whether this reaches 8.0 is unknown until recaptured and blind-scored.
